propositions: The bedrock_model_id field is parsed from REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID and [tool.rebar.llm] bedrock_model_id, documented in module docstring and docs/env-vars.md, but never consumed anywhere in the codebase.
Setting REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID silently produces no effect; the documented knob does not change the model that is actually used.
The actual working model path uses cfg.model with the provider-prefixed string 'bedrock:<inference-profile-id>', which is parsed by providers.py and tested in the codebase.
A duplicate DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID literal exists in bedrock_model.py kept in sync by hand-written comment, making bedrock_model_id field removal leave only the module's own definition.
The field has never shipped (change 1043 is unsubmitted) so removal is not a compatibility break and is safer than wiring the inert knob.
